posts.title: Missing in action and rebuilding my life
posts.description: My apologies, but I've been missing in action for the past, well, a long time. Over the past 8 or 9 months or so, I've experienced a couple of life changing events. posts.description: This is going to be a struggle. I'm not much of a writer and writing about losing my best friend in the whole world will make it even more difficult. posts.title: Dreams of the internet of years past
posts.description: Honestly, I'm tired of what the internet has become. I've been around since the internet started and it was so much fun back then. There was a lot of creativity, a lot of community, and just a lot of positive things happening and connecting the world. What's it like today?
